review_rn2.act_on: FRODO. Do not hand Galadriel. safeTimezone() must not return a string new DateTimeZone rejects. On PHP 8.4.25 (cli built Aug 28 2026, Timezone Database internal, Olson 0.system) ALL_WITH_BC has 500 ids and omits US/Central, US/Eastern, US/Pacific, Asia/Calcutta. new DateTimeZone throws for each. timezone_open returns false and warns. America/Chicago, America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles, and Asia/Kolkata construct. ClickHouse accepts toDateTime(..., 'US/Central'). ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::safeTimezone('US/Central') returns US/Central, then handleSql() throws Carbon\Exceptions\InvalidTimeZoneException inside toUtcDatetime() before SQL, and now(tz: 'US/Central') throws the same. RecoveryCounts::ratioMonthlySeries() calls now(tz:) before scansTimezone is stored, so Jeff's test errors instead of asserting US/Central. CompanyMetricsOverview::getStats() has no per-card try, so the throw 500s the grid. Pre-tip UTC fallback did not throw. CST, PST, +05:00, and garbage must stay UTC. Do not copy the unconstructable early return onto KitRangePathsQuery. Shape: keep the four-alias allowlist; if new \DateTimeZone($alias) succeeds, return the alias (identity-keep); on DateInvalidTimeZoneException return the canonical id (US/Central→America/Chicago, US/Eastern→America/New_York, US/Pacific→America/Los_Angeles, Asia/Calcutta→Asia/Kolkata), never UTC and never throw from safeTimezone(). Do not use timezone_open (it warns). Mirror only on KitScanPathsQuery. One zone for handle() bounds and grouping. Update the contract test and the three widget providers so the expected zone is the alias when constructable and the canonical id when not, and assert new DateTimeZone(safeTimezone($alias)) does not throw and handleSql with timezone US/Central gets past toUtcDatetime. Docblock: identity-keep only when PHP can construct the alias. US/* and America/* are not historically identical; that is not a reason to return an unconstructable string. Re-prove on PHP 8.4.25. Frodo's PHP 8.4.23 run stays green either way.
